artist.name: CODOT
artist.description: Independent sound. Uncompromising expression. Welcome to the world of CODOT.
artist.bio:
C.o.d.o.t. (Clearly Out Doing Other Tracks) - Is an edgy hard hitting stable of MC’s in the likes of which the music industry hasn't heard in decades. Their raw street deliveries and rhyme schemes blend with intellectual socio-political views that are hard to turn a deaf ear to. Jon E Fontane, Dokk Symfone, Black Def, and Bobby Bane unified their talents in 2012 to form the hip hop super group C.o.d.o.t.

Born and raised in Flint, MI. C.o.d.o.t. first hit the music scene as The Coalition with their debut release” Check the Illy” in 1999. After their second release ”World's Greatest Demo” in 2002 The Coalition disbanded to pursue solo projects. Over the next decade due to their city’s mismanagement, group members took up residence in other states across the country .

In 2012, the group, minus one member (Carmel Nino), decided it was time to join forces again. Now hailing from Atlanta, GA (Black Def), Phoenix, AZ (Bobby Bane), Seattle, WA (Dokk Symfone), and Flint, MI (Jon E Fontane) this mighty foursome should not be taken lightly. With their  next single ”We Killaz” due to release in 2017, Co.d.o.t. is sure to catch the attention of every hip hop head, music lover, and surely any artist thinking of breathing on a microphone.
